name: Candid Crop
description: A tight, deliberate editorial crop on the product mid-stride in a real environment — a wrist, hand, or ankle caught in genuine motion with real foreground/background depth — the register of a street-style photographer's candid detail shot, not a studio product macro. The crop is art-directed, never accidental.
lighting: Natural outdoor light, real environmental depth
subject: either
prompt: an extreme close editorial crop isolating a single point of contact between a person and the product — a wrist, a hand, an ankle — caught mid-stride in a real outdoor environment, genuine environmental depth with a softly blurred foreground element crossing part of the frame and a real cityscape or streetscape dissolving into soft bokeh behind, natural outdoor daylight with true photographic falloff, shallow depth of field keeping the product and the immediately adjacent skin tack-sharp while everything else falls into genuine optical blur, authentic motion in the limb or fabric implying real walking energy rather than a static studio pose, the crop boundary reading as a deliberate photographer's choice — tight, confident, intentional — never an accidental or awkward cutoff, no face in frame, no second person, premium editorial street-campaign register
